title: Ionic transport in hybrid lead iodide perovskite solar cells
finding: DFT+experiment establish iodide vacancy migration (~0.58 eV) as the dominant transport channel in MAPbI3, seeding the field's mechanistic picture.

title: Defect migration in methylammonium lead iodide and its role in perovskite solar cell operation
finding: First-principles defect migration in MAPbI3 finds iodide the most mobile species and links its motion to hysteresis.

title: First-Principles Study of Ion Diffusion in Perovskite Solar Cell Sensitizers
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
finding: First-principles ion-diffusion study confirms the iodide vacancy as lowest-barrier migrating defect and maps concerted pathways.

title: Iodine chemistry determines the defect tolerance of lead-halide perovskites
finding: Iodine redox chemistry (I-rich vs I-poor) governs which deep vs shallow defects form, explaining perovskite defect tolerance.

title: Self‐Regulation Mechanism for Charged Point Defects in Hybrid Halide Perovskites
finding: Self-regulation of charged point defects keeps Fermi level pinned and native defects mostly shallow — the basis of defect tolerance.

title: Intrinsic Point Defects in Inorganic Cesium Lead Iodide Perovskite CsPbI3
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
finding: Intrinsic point-defect calculations in inorganic CsPbI3 identify dominant vacancies/interstitials and their charge states — directly the project's system.

title: Anomalous Hysteresis in Perovskite Solar Cells
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
finding: Identifies anomalous J-V hysteresis in perovskite cells and proposes slow ionic/defect processes as a leading cause.

title: Ion Migration in Organometal Trihalide Perovskite and Its Impact on Photovoltaic Efficiency and Stability
finding: Review synthesizing evidence that mobile ions drive hysteresis, switchable photovoltaics, and giant dielectric response.

title: Quantification of ion migration in CH 3 NH 3 PbI 3 perovskite solar cells by transient capacitance measurements
finding: Transient ion-drift measurements quantify densities and activation energies of migrating species, separating cation from anion motion.

title: Grain boundary dominated ion migration in polycrystalline organic–inorganic halide perovskite films
finding: Direct imaging shows ion migration is dominated by grain boundaries in polycrystalline films, far faster than through bulk grains.

title: A multiscale ion diffusion framework sheds light on the diffusion–stability–hysteresis nexus in metal halide perovskites
finding: Multiscale framework reconciles wide barrier scatter by showing grain boundaries and morphology set effective diffusion, not single-crystal barriers.

title: Reversible photo-induced trap formation in mixed-halide hybrid perovskites for photovoltaics
finding: Discovers reversible light-induced halide segregation (the Hoke effect) in mixed-halide perovskites, a migration-driven instability.

title: Phase segregation due to ion migration in all-inorganic mixed-halide perovskite nanocrystals
finding: Demonstrates ion-migration-driven phase segregation in all-inorganic mixed-halide CsPb(I/Br)3, linking it to vacancy motion.

title: Migration of cations induces reversible performance losses over day/night cycling in perovskite solar cells
finding: Distinguishes fast reversible from slow cation-migration-induced performance losses over hours of operation, an interfacial-accumulation signature.

title: Cation and anion immobilization through chemical bonding enhancement with fluorides for stable halide perovskite solar cells
finding: Cation and anion immobilization via chemical-bond enhancement suppresses migration and boosts operational stability.

title: Suppressing ion migration in metal halide perovskite via interstitial doping with a trace amount of multivalent cations
finding: Interstitial doping immobilizes mobile halides, raising migration barriers and suppressing ion transport (project anchor).

title: Rethinking the A cation in halide perovskites
finding: Rethinking the A-cation: bulky guanidinium-type cations raise the iodide-migration barrier, the 'pinning' concept central to the project.

title: Ion Migration at Metal Halide Perovskite Grain Boundaries Elucidated with a Machine Learning Force Field
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
finding: Machine-learning force field resolves ion migration at perovskite grain boundaries with near-DFT accuracy at MD length/time scales.

title: Tracing Ion Migration in Halide Perovskites with Machine Learned Force Fields
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
finding: Machine-learned force field traces ion-migration trajectories and barrier distributions in halide perovskites across charge states.

title: Ion Migration and Dopant Effects in the Gamma-CsPbI3 Perovskite Photovoltaic Material: Atomistic Insights through Ab Initio and Machine Learning Methods
finding: MLIP-driven NEB quantifies dopant effects on iodide-vacancy migration in gamma-CsPbI3 — the project's exact methodology and system.

title: Ion migration in perovskite solar cells
finding: Recent review consolidating ion-migration mechanisms, measurement, and mitigation in perovskite solar cells.

title: A Unified microscopic picture of cation and anion migration in MAPbI$_3$
finding: Unified MLIP picture of both cation and anion migration in MAPbI3, extending force-field migration studies to full ion inventory.
